searchText: One of the condition to verify persistent committee votes > 2/3 threshold can potentially overflow `assert 3 * sum(filter(lambda i: update.aggregation_bits[i], balances)) > 2 * sum(balances)` Not possible given the current config though. Maybe 1 day when effective balance or validator count drastically increases
